title: Isomorphisms of sheaf modules are local on an open covering
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let $\{U_a\hookrightarrow X\}_{a\in A}$ be an open covering, and let $\alpha:\mathcal M\to\mathcal N$ be a morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Then $\alpha$ is an isomorphism if and only if each restriction $\alpha|_{U_a}:\mathcal M|_{U_a}\to\mathcal N|_{U_a}$ is an isomorphism. This is the locality criterion for sheaf morphisms (Stacks, Sheaves, Lemma 00WY).

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma 00WY (a morphism of sheaves is an isomorphism iff it is so on an open covering)

mathlib_searches.query: a morphism of sheaves is an isomorphism if and only if its restrictions to an open covering are isomorphisms
mathlib_searches.results: Sheaf.isIso_iff_of_coversTop and related cover-local isomorphism criteria for sheaves; no direct ringed-space module declaration.
Sheaf.isIso_iff_of_coversTop (generic sheaves over a Grothendieck topology), not stated for sheaves of modules on topological spaces.
